an5.44:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.44:1.2: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena uggassa gahapatino vesālikassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an5.44:1.3: atha kho uggo gahapati vesāliko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uggo gahapati vesāliko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.44:2.1: “sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:2.4: taṃ me bhagavā patigaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
an5.44:3.1: “sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:3.4: taṃ me bhagavā patigaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
an5.44:4.1: “sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:4.4: taṃ me bhagavā patigaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
an5.44:5.1: “sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:5.3: manāpaṃ me bhante sālīnaṃ odano vicitakāḷako anekasūpo anekabyañjano.
an5.44:5.4: taṃ me bhagavā patigaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
an5.44:6.1: “sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:6.4: tāni me bhagavā patigaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
an5.44:7.1: “sammukhā metaṃ bhante bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ
an5.44:7.3: manāpo me bhante pallaṅko goṇakatthato paṭikatthato paṭalikatthato kādalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato lohitakūpadhāno.
an5.44:7.6: idaṃ me bhante candanaphalakaṃ agghati adhikaṃ sahassaṃ.
an5.44:7.7: taṃ me bhagavā patigaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti
an5.44:7.9: atha kho bhagavā uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ iminā anumodanīyena anumodi:
an5.44:10.1: atha kho bhagavā uggaṃ gahapatiṃ vesālikaṃ iminā anumodanīyena anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an5.44:11.1: atha kho uggo gahapati vesāliko aparena samayena kālamakāsi.
an5.44:11.2: kālakato ca uggo gahapati vesāliko aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapajjī.
an5.44:11.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anātha piṇḍikassa ārāme
an5.44:11.4: atha kho uggo devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho uggaṃ devaputtaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an5.44:11.7: atha kho bhagavā uggaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
